name: linkwarden-mcp
description: MCP server for Linkwarden bookmarks: read-first search and preserved content, with opt-in write, delete, and collection-delete tools.

LINKWARDEN_MCP_WRITE_SCOPES.title: Write scopes
LINKWARDEN_MCP_WRITE_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated domains for create/update: links,collections,tags,raw. Recommended: links,collections. Empty = read-only.

LINKWARDEN_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES.title: Delete scopes
LINKWARDEN_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated domains for delete only. Never implied by write scopes. Empty = no deletes.
